sources.title: ggmlc/examples/laya at main · monatis/ggmlc · GitHub
sources.snippet: The runner does not switch on model family. Already-distributed Laya GGUFs (english / multilingual / typed-decisions) predate that key. If ggmlc.decision is missing, laya.exe assumes the built-in Laya preprocessor so existing downloads keep working. Do not ship any non-Laya GGUF without ggmlc.decision.

sources.title: Laya — 33ms Multilingual System 1 Decision Engine
sources.snippet: From our March 2025 arXiv paper on sequence conversion trajectories to Laya: a sub-35ms open-weight System 1 decision engine with RLCD, multilingual routing across 100+ languages, and state-of-the-art calibration.
